summary: Mobilicom Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 27, 2026, containing a press release with first quarter 2026 financial highlights and a business update. The filing reports $2.2 million in new orders from a U.S. Tier-1 customer for a U.S. Department of War Program of Record, progress in the U.S. Army's LASSO program through a Tier-1 defense partner, two new design wins with U.S. Tier-1 drone platforms, and receipt of FCC Trusted Drone status. The company had $17.7 million in cash and no debt. This is a routine earnings and operational update, not a special situation.
